The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye beside the laser welding machine. The panda mascot: a chubby black-and-white giant panda with black eye patches and a round white face, always wearing a bright yellow hard hat, clear safety goggles and a green cross badge on its chest. The female graduate student: a young Chinese woman with a black ponytail, always wearing a knee-length white lab coat, long pants, closed-toe shoes and safety goggles. The young male student: a young Chinese man with short curly hair, always wearing a light gray hoodie under an open white lab coat. The facility engineer: a stocky Chinese man about forty-five, always wearing a dark gray work uniform, a white hard hat and a tool belt. Medium close-up of the panda mascot, facing the camera with its whole face clearly visible and nothing in front of its mouth (props are held low, below the chin). The panda speaks the line with clearly visible, well-synchronized mouth movements: "开关换好了，下次见！" Its mouth moves only while speaking and closes when the line ends; nobody else talks. Audio: only one voice, a warm, clear young female Mandarin Chinese narrator voice at a natural, steady pace, speaking standard Putonghua; light soft background ambience, no music. Walls are plain and clean, with no posters, whiteboards or signs unless described above; all books, screens, charts, calendars and labels are blank solid color shapes or simple pictograms; doors are plain, and any door plate, room sign or nameplate on or above a door is a blank solid-color panel with no characters, letters or numbers; shelves, binders and bottles have no labels. Absolutely no text, no letters, no Chinese characters, no numbers, no writing anywhere in the frame; no subtitles, no captions, no title bars, no speech bubbles; the spoken line is audio only and is never written on screen.
